Nevada casinos won nearly $15.8 billion from gamblers in 2025, a fifth straight record, even as Las Vegas had 7.5% fewer visitors. This video breaks down how casinos are built to win: the house edge hidden in every payout (with the roulette math), 6-to-5 blackjack, baccarat's commission, slot hold, and how churn turns a small edge into big money, using MGM Resorts' 2025 10-K. It also shows the surprise that hotel rooms now out-earn gambling on the Las Vegas Strip, and where the house can still lose.
